_comment: DEVELOPMENT EXAMPLE ONLY — NOT APPROVED PRICES. Lets the fashion quote/bag flow be exercised locally. The server only honours an unapproved profile when P3_ALLOW_UNAPPROVED_PRICING=true, and the UI then labels every price as an unapproved estimate. reference_dims_mm is an ILLUSTRATIVE placeholder chosen by the implementer, not a product decision: the CPP tray-packing and print-time terms depend on it. Vermeil plating is not costed (plating_cost_usd=null). See docs/PRICING.md.
